name: Therylune
summary: At the Master's Glaive in southern Darkshore, Therylune waits for a chance to escape her captors. Twilight's Hammer cultists have trapped the dryad at the ancient site, and she needs a traveler's help to reach safety.

sections.title: Captive of the Cult
sections.body: Therylune is a dryad, a daughter of Cenarius who guards nature. She came from the tranquil woodlands of northern Kalimdor to the Master's Glaive in southern Darkshore. Twilight's Hammer cultists have gathered at the ancient excavation and ambushed her. Surrounded by their swarms, she cannot fight her way free alone. She needs an escort through the cultists and out to safety.

faq.answer: Therylune is a dryad, one of the woodland daughters of the demigod Cenarius. Twilight's Hammer cultists have captured her at the Master's Glaive in southern Darkshore.

faq.q: Why is Therylune trapped at the Master's Glaive?
faq.answer: Therylune was ambushed and pinned down by Twilight's Hammer cultists. They have established a dark camp around the giant petrified remains at the Master's Glaive.
Yes. Therylune is the sister of Therysil, another dryad who dwells in the woodlands of northern Kalimdor.

faq.q: What happens once you help her escape?
faq.answer: Once you clear a path through the hostile cultists, Therylune flees the Master's Glaive and returns to the safety of the surrounding wilds.

angles.text: As a druid, you share a kinship with Cenarius and his kin. You feel an urgent duty to rescue a dryad captured by malevolent cultists.
As a night elf, you share ancient, sacred ties with the daughters of Cenarius. Therylune's captivity at Twilight's Hammer's hands is an affront to Kalimdor's balance.
